title: Trade Documentation Charge on Vehicle Purchase Agreements Orders
content:
**Charge.** For a signed order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements that is not an exchange replacement, a trade-in linked to the order adds a trade documentation charge to the documentation fee. The charge is read from the accepted agreement in Trade-In Agreements that is linked to the order, and from whether that agreement names a lienholder.

| Trade-in on the order | Trade documentation charge |
|---|---|
| an accepted trade-in agreement linked to the order names a lienholder | $60.00 (the lien release charge) |
| an accepted trade-in agreement linked to the order names no lienholder | $25.00 (the clear-title charge) |
| no accepted trade-in agreement is linked | none |

**Hypothetical cases.**
- A buyer trades in a car with a loan still owed to a bank, the accepted agreement naming that bank as lienholder: $60.00.
- A buyer trades in a car owned outright, the accepted agreement naming no lienholder: $25.00.
- A trade-in offer that was cancelled or never accepted: no trade documentation charge.
